lead.headline: Central Connecticut has won three straight
lead.deck: The Blue Devils are 3-2 after an overtime win at Dartmouth. Le Moyne rates highest in the league.
body: Hardwood Bricks now covers the Northeast Conference, nine schools from Easton and New Britain through Brooklyn and Staten Island to Syracuse, Erie and Chicago. Every game gets a preview, a recap, a line history and a spot in our ratings.
Central Connecticut won 78-71 in overtime at Dartmouth and 79-75 at Sacred Heart, then beat Quinnipiac 72-67 at home.
Le Moyne rates highest in the NEC at 277th. The Dolphins beat Manhattan 76-62.
Chicago State won 66-54 at Incarnate Word and 81-62 at California Baptist.

column.label: By the Numbers
column.title: Three numbers from the first two weeks
body: **117.** Wagner's points against Bryant & Stratton-Albany, the league's high.
**37.** Stonehill's points at Texas Tech, the league's low.
**5.** NEC teams rated between 277th and 306th in our ratings: Le Moyne, LIU, New Haven, Central Connecticut and Wagner.

notes.headline: FDU in overtime
notes.body: Fairleigh Dickinson won 80-76 in overtime at East Texas A&M.

notes.headline: LIU still looking
notes.body: The Sharks are 0-5. Their closest game was a 67-60 loss at Seton Hall.

notes.headline: A long trip list
notes.body: NEC teams have already played at Illinois, Texas, Syracuse, Notre Dame, UConn, Oklahoma and Texas Tech.

notes.headline: One bid
notes.body: The NEC tournament in March decides the league's NCAA bid.
